entry.title: Article 4: Lunenburg MART Connect transportation program: Select Board, 2024-10-08
entry.summary: Council on Aging meal site and program budget. The Council on Aging may request more hours for the Meal Site Manager and an increase to the program line item; warrant articles are expected for MART Connect and the meals site revolving fund. No dollar figure is printed.

entry.title: Article 4: Lunenburg MART Connect transportation program: Council on Aging, 2024-10-08
entry.summary: MART CONNECT transportation article. A Special Town Meeting article would ask the Town to appropriate $20,000.00 to support the Lunenburg MART CONNECT program, which began with a MART grant in July 2023 that ran through June 2024.
